description: The source describes International Roughness Index and rut-depth measurements on provincial highways, summarised for 50-metre segments within the measured lane. Package metadata covers 2003–2013 and links a transportation information page. This is road-asset condition data with explicit lane and segment resolution. It does not state instrument type, units, traffic loading, lane identifiers or downloadable encoding. No current condition is inferred from the historical series. The referenced information route and data bodies remain separate access checks. The Canadian Urban Data Catalogue supplies the original Alberta identifiers and distribution descriptions. The source names Open Government Licence - Alberta. Costs and present file access remain unverified. This record covers inspected descriptive metadata; no dataset, document, archive or linked resource body was fetched. Specific simulation uses are unstated unless described above. Unlisted fields and numerical values remain unknown.
